label: FY2027 School Board Budget Resolution (Adopted)
text:
Loudoun County Public Schools

 PROCLAMATION

 Loudoun County Public Schools Budget Resolution

WHEREAS, it is the mission of the Loudoun County Public Schools (LCPS) to empower all
students to make meaningful contributions to the world; and

WHEREAS, the Loudoun County School Board has approved, and is committed to
implementing, the One LCPS Strategic Plan for Excellence, to provide direction for our school
division through 2027; and

WHEREAS, the One LCPS Strategic Plan for Excellence establishes four primary goals of
Empowered Students, Exemplary Staff, Enriched Division, and Engaged Community; and

WHEREAS, the Loudoun County School Board has thusly reviewed the financial needs and
priorities for the upcoming school year; and

WHEREAS, the County of Loudoun, Virginia, through its Board of Supervisors, has provided
guidance on local tax revenues to be appropriated to the school division; and

WHEREAS, the Commonwealth of Virginia’s Superintendent of Public Instruction has provided
estimated revenues for Basic Aid, Sales Tax, and other state funding; and

WHEREAS, the Loudoun County School Board directed the development of this Fiscal Year
2027 (FY27) Budget to be afforded by projected County and state revenues and to include
necessary resources for continuity of operations, continuing investments, and new investments
that fulfill the LCPS strategic plan and mission; and

WHEREAS, the Loudoun County School Board is committed to recruiting, retaining, and
developing staff and entered into collective bargaining agreements that include, but are not
limited to, step increases for all eligible employees; a one-time 1% top of scale payment to
eligible employees; a 4% cost of living increase for certified bargaining unit employees (Salary
Scales A and C), a 5% cost of living increase for non-certified bargaining unit employees (Salary
Scales A and B), and the introduction of bereavement leave. Further, all eligible non-bargaining
unit employees shall also receive step increases; a one-time 1% top of scale payment for
eligible employees; and a cost of living adjustment ranging from 4% to 5%, based on position
and level; and

WHEREAS, the Loudoun County School Board acknowledges competitive stipends and hourly
banded pay rates are vital for recognizing employee contributions and attracting skilled
personnel and approves the adoption of the stipends and hourly banded pay rates as outlined in
the FY27 Adopted Budget; and
 1

WHEREAS, the Loudoun County School Board is committed to supporting employee well-being
and retention through the provision of competitive benefits and approves the adoption of a
benefits plan that aligns with the school division’s fiscal policies and budget priorities; and

WHEREAS, the Loudoun County School Board recognizes the equitable allocation of resources
to schools is essential to supporting student achievement and approves the school allotments
as outlined in the FY27 Adopted Budget.
